subject: Kickoff: vendor questionnaire & SOC 2 snapshot — clarifying asks and next steps
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit@cedarcloud.health>; Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@cedarcloud.health>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: vendor questionnaire & SOC 2 snapshot — clarifying asks and next steps

Thanks again for the demo earlier, Amit and Lena — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary from call:
- CedarCloud is evaluating an inference provider for clinical summarization and anonymized analytics.
- Primary concerns: HIPAA flow of PHI, SOC 2 evidence, data residency, and subprocessor controls.

What we need to proceed (asks):
1) SOC 2 status: please share the most recent SOC 2 Type II report or a SOC2 snapshot if you have an in-progress audit.
2) Preferred questionnaire format: SIG/CAIQ preferred; if you have a custom vendor form we can fill that too — let us know which you prefer.
3) Data flow clarification: a short note on whether PHI is sent to our hosted API or processed within a VPC/on-prem path. (helps scope HIPAA-specific evidence).
4) Timeline: target procurement/compliance deadline for a completed questionnaire and evidence.

To make it easy, I attached a short SIG template we can prefill and return; if you prefer CAIQ we’ll convert.

Proposed next steps:
- You: share SOC2 snapshot (or confirm not available) + preference on SIG/CAIQ/custom by EOD Wed.
- Us: start prefill once format confirmed and line up security to prepare the evidence map.
- Schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to review completed prefill and outstanding evidence items.

Clarifying questions we had for your security/privacy team (to help avoid back-and-forth):
- Are there any third-party subprocessors beyond AWS and Segment we should note?
- Is data retained in an encrypted form at rest and in transit? Any specifics on KMS/HSM usage?
- Do you have a documented data retention policy for analytics-derived artifacts?

Attachment: SIG_template.xlsx (stub) — this is a blank prefill with common Redwood asks.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Grace (security partner) and Monica (CS) to help with mapping once we get your preference.

Best,
David
David Kim
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Amit Shah <amit@cedarcloud.health>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>; Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@cedarcloud.health>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vendor questionnaire & SOC 2 snapshot — clarifying asks and next steps

David — thanks for the recap and clear asks. Quick answers from my side: 

- SOC 2: we completed Type II in May 2027. I attached a redacted snapshot (SOC2_snapshot_2027-05.pdf).
- Questionnaire format: CAIQ would be easiest for us; we can also accept a prefilled SIG if you prefer.
- Data flow: PHI is pseudonymized before leaving our ingestion cluster; for clinical summaries, PHI is tokenized and sent to the inference endpoint in our VPC. We have a hybrid setup (hosted + VPC paths) depending on the customer.
- Subprocessors: AWS (EKS, S3), Snowflake (analytics), and Sentry (error monitoring).

Two clarifying Qs for your security team: 
1) For VPC/on-prem deployment, does Redwood require additional VPN or peering steps?
2) If we share a redacted SOC2 with a standard NDA, do you have a preferred channel for evidence exchange?

Attaching SOC2_snapshot_2027-05.pdf. Happy to hop on a 30-min call to walk security through architecture if that helps.

—Amit
Amit Shah
Head of InfoSec, CedarCloud Health
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit@cedarcloud.health>, Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@cedarcloud.health>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vendor questionnaire & SOC 2 snapshot — clarifying asks and next steps

Appreciate the SOC2 snapshot, Amit — that helps a lot. We can work from CAIQ or SIG; preference from our side is SIG prefill since it maps tightly to vendor intake processes for enterprises, but we'll happily convert to CAIQ if that is easier for you.

Answers to your two questions: 
- VPC/on-prem: For VPC we typically request either customer-managed VPC peering or a private link endpoint; we can share a short network checklist after we better understand your preferred deployment. For on-prem we have an appliance-based option and a documented VPN setup — Grace will follow up with specifics.
- Evidence exchange: a secured S3 share or a password-protected Drive link is best; we can also accept evidence via signed DocuSign for privileged documents — we’ll share the preferred template once NDA is in place.

Next asks from our side (small list):
- Can you confirm whether PHI leaves your VPC before pseudonymization for any workflows? That affects HIPAA control mapping.
- When would you like Redwood to complete the SIG prefill? We can turn it around in 2–3 business days once we have the CAIQ/SIG preference and SOC2 artifacts.

I attached a SIG_template.xlsx to make the prefill easy on your side.

Forwarding to Monica for intake review and to Grace for any red-team evidence asks.

Best,
David

Quick internal note: 
- SOC2 snapshot looks standard but redactions hide control owner names — ask for either full SOC2 under NDA or a control mapping (test names and timestamps) so our audit team can sign off.
- Ask security for: encryption at rest specifics (KMS key rotation policy), penetration test scope, and the list of subprocessors with contract flow-down clauses.
- Recommend we prefill SIG and include a parallel CAIQ export; this reduces turnaround for enterprise buyers who request either.

I can draft the evidence request list if you want; looping Grace to confirm technical evidence needs.

—Monica
From: Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@cedarcloud.health>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit@cedarcloud.health>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vendor questionnaire & SOC 2 snapshot — clarifying asks and next steps

David/Monica/Grace — attaching a completed SIG_prefill.xlsx with our initial answers and a short architecture diagram (link in Drive). We also included a brief control mapping CSV for the SOC2 snapshot under NDA.

Answers to your outstanding clarifying points: 
- PHI processing: pseudonymization occurs at the ingestion layer; de-tokenization only occurs in isolated on-prem connectors for select customers. No raw PHI is sent to third-party monitoring tools.
- Subprocessors: confirmed AWS, Snowflake, Sentry, and a contracted MLops vendor (MLOpsOne) — added contact for MLOpsOne in the prefill.
- Evidence sharing: we'll provision a restricted Drive folder and share a link; SOC2 full report available under our standard NDA.

Next step: please confirm receipt and let us know a couple of 30-min windows next week to review prefill and outstanding evidence.

Attachment: SIG_prefill.xlsx (stub).

Thanks,
Lena
Lena Brooks
Product & Compliance Lead
CedarCloud Health
